# @stacklatte/chart-core (renamed)

> Deprecated name. Re-exports @stacklatte/chart-native (React Native/Skia renderer) and, at `/core`, @stacklatte/chart-engine. Use those packages for new code; their llms.txt files are canonical.

- React Native app → ../chart-native/llms.txt
- Web app → ../chart-web/llms.txt
- Indicators / ChartConfig / JSON Schema only → ../chart-engine/llms.txt
